result.analyst_notes: Heritage-focused and first-person plural, with a retrospective, reassuring tone. Customers are named as the priority in the closing paragraph. Commitments are mostly absolute ('must never lose sight'), while accountability is framed through admitted mistakes. Much of the text is business scale description, which is not coded as values.
